dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned reports and area feed county influence.
Influence and FIPS geography feed external gravity.
External influence and current trend feed spread change.
Spread change feeds one-step and multi-step baseline validation.
Validated trend interface feeds origin and threshold application.
Application results motivate socio-economic association screening.
Selected factors feed adjusted trend and policy counterfactual.
Adjusted result and policy curve feed sensitivity and DEA memo.
Baseline metrics remain the comparison frame for deployment.
